newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NIS rates ASIA Ltd claims paying ability AA+.
newsitem.headline: NIS rates ASIA Ltd claims paying ability AA+.

text.p: Financial guarantee insurer Asian Securitization & Infrastructure Assurance (Pte) Ltd (ASIA Ltd) said on Monday it had received an AA+ claims paying ability rating from Nippon Investors Service Inc (NIS).
ASIA chief executive Philip Sherman told Reuters the rating from Japan's NIS was important "because the largest source of investment capital for this part of the world is in Japan".

NIS said its rating reflected ASIA's high underwriting standards and the support provided by the Capital Markets Assurance Corporation, of which ASIA is an affiliate, along with the Asian Development Bank and the Government of Singapore Investment Corporation, ASIA said in a statememt.
ASIA Ltd was founded in December 1995 and began operations in May 1996. It is rated AA by Duff & Phelps and A by Standard and Poor's.
